name: Tank
description: A main battle tank on two tracks: very heavy, quick for its size on the road, and it turns on the spot. A and D run one track faster than the other; standing still they turn the tracks opposite ways and it pivots. The turret is a drawn block and does not turn.
comment: A vehicle preset (#728, #448): see sedan.json for the format. movementType tracked is the Tracked movement type (#448): each side's road wheels (the layout's axles, a pair each) share one belt, every one driven and braked by the handbrake, none steered; it steers by running one track faster than the other, and in a pivot the tracks run opposite ways at chassis.tracked.pivotTrackSpeed. Reference: the Leopard 2A4, hull and drive only. Sourced: combat weight 55,150 kg (FAS data sheet; KNDS lists 55 t); 1,103 kW (1,500 hp) at 2,600 rpm (KNDS, Singapore MINDEF); top speed 68 km/h on the road (Canada DND; KNDS up to 70), so maxSpeed 1889 cm/s is the governor; ground pressure 0.83 kg/cm^2 (FAS, Canada DND); hull 7.7 m long and 3.75 m wide. Estimates: peak torque 4,700 Nm (the MTU MB 873's, secondary sources) on a flat torque curve peaking at 1,600 to 1,700 rpm; the gearbox's ratios (Renk HSWL 354, 4 forward, 2 reverse) are not published, so 4.3, 2.6, 1.6 and 1.0 step geometrically and with finalDrive 5.0 4th turns the 35 cm road wheels at 68.6 km/h at 2,600 rpm; reverse 2.2 tops out near 31 km/h (estimate); 7 road wheels a side of 35 cm radius, 60 cm wide, the first to the last 490 cm apart (layout.wheelbase); track width 63.5 cm (estimate); the gauge 310 cm (layout.track: the 375 cm hull less a track's width); pivotTrackSpeed 97 cm/s turns it 360 degrees in about 10 s (2 x 97 / 310 rad/s; no published hull figure, an estimate); lateralShare 0.8 (steel tracks on firm ground, U. Maryland ENAE 788X after Wong, Theory of Ground Vehicles); padPitch 18 cm. Checks (validate.py prints them): contact length l = 490 + 35 = 525 cm, l / gauge = 1.69 (real tanks 1.5 to 1.8), x lateralShare 0.8 = 1.35, below the 2 it must stay under to pivot; ground pressure 55,150 / (2 x 63.5 x 525) = 0.83 kg/cm^2, the FAS figure. brakeTorque 8,100 Nm on each of 14 road wheels stops it at about 0.6 g (estimate); handbrake 10,000 Nm holds it parked on a slope. Real tanks have neither ABS nor traction control, so both are off (a creator may switch them on). tires.rollingResistance 0.04: a track loses far more than a tyre to its pins and road wheels (#448, shared with #447). tires.friction 1.18 is the track's grip multiplier (1.6 x 0.735: the tyre load is the true load since #376 step 9); the movement type has its own track grip per surface. Suspension: torsion bars with long travel (25 cm up, 22 down) riding at about 1.1 Hz (estimate: tank torsion bars ride near 1 Hz); springRate 1,050 is the average road wheel's (each follows its own load), the 20 cm it sags at rest taken from the droop, and damping 4.6 gives a damping ratio near 0.27 for the 3.9 t each road wheel carries (#376 step 9's ride bars). The turret (460 x 330 x 80 cm on the hull's top, centred at x 0) is drawn only; the hull collides. Centre of mass 20 cm behind the middle (the engine at the back) and 110 cm up. Camera arm and height suit a 7.7 m, 2.5 m tall vehicle. Tuning after the probe (#448) may move the engine, brake and friction numbers.
